title: The Steaming Pool
text: A hot spring in the rocks, clear and steaming, in a place so cold the breath freezes on the lips. The water is warm as blood. Moss grows green around its edge. Each Scion can take a moment in it, or keep watch on the dark around.

options.label: Sink into the warm water, and let the cold go out of you.

outcomes.text: The heat goes into the bones and takes the aches out with it.
Something in the water was waiting for a warm body.

options.label: Keep watch on the dark while the others rest.

outcomes.text: Nothing comes. Someone has to watch anyway, and they learn a great deal about the dark.
